tested:
Wave 21 U2/U3 (2026-09-05): the image IS held now - `alienvault-ossim-5.8.5.tgz` was
imported from Downloads. What the vendor ships is an INSTALL SET, not a pre-installed
appliance: a blank 50 GiB `hda.qcow2` (196 KiB allocated, measured with `qemu-img info`)
plus a 756 MB bootable `cdrom.iso`. EVE-NG runs it exactly this way - their
`alienvault.yml` carries `-boot order=cd`, which in QEMU means "hard disk first, CD-ROM
second". That order is safe to pin statically (unlike the cdrom-FIRST order rejected for
openbsd above): the blank disk simply falls through to the installer, and once OSSIM is
installed the same static order boots the disk instead. `ethernet: 2`, `cpu: 4`,
`ram: 6144` and `console: vnc` below already match their template.

settings.description: AlienVault USM/OSSIM (Unified Security Management) - SIEM/threat detection. Ships as a blank disk plus a bootable installer ISO; the node opens on the vendor's own graphical installer over VNC.
